meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: 它会先扫描你机器上的 OpenClaw 安装，汇总身份、频道凭据、工作区文件、定时任务等；再分阶段陪你逐项决定迁移到 NanoClaw v2，改动前先展示，凭据显示时打码。
howto.when: 当你提到「migrate from openclaw」「openclaw migration」「import from openclaw」，或要求把 OpenClaw 迁到 NanoClaw v2 时触发。

howto.what_en: It scans your machine for an existing OpenClaw install, summarizes identity, channel credentials, workspace files and scheduled tasks, then walks you through migrating to NanoClaw v2 phase by phase, showing changes before applying.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration" or "import from openclaw", i.e. when you ask to move an OpenClaw setup over to NanoClaw v2.

say_en.text: Migrate my OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2
say_en.note: Runs discovery and summarizes your install

say_en.text: Import my OpenClaw channels and credentials
Migrate just the primary agent, add groups later
